title: India's unemployment rate eases to eight-month low of 4.9% in October
description:
India's unemployment rate declined marginally to 4.9 per cent in October from 5 per cent in September, as female labour force participation and workforce participation improved, particularly in rural areas, according to government data released on Monday.
The overall unemployment rate for people aged 15 years and above was also 0.3 percentage points lower than the 5.2 per cent recorded in October 2025, the latest Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) bulletin released by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation showed.
Overall urban unemployment declined to 6.7 per cent from 6.9 per cent in September, while rural unemployment remained unchanged at 4.2 per cent.
The improvement was accompanied by an increase in the female Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR), which rose to 35 per cent in October from 34.6 per cent in September and 34.2 per cent a year earlier, reaching its highest level since February 2026.
